price_scope: Public Pods pricing page default displayed cards; actual region, availability and checkout price must be checked before rental. Not Serverless pricing.

phases.purpose: Verify the exact cloud GPU, profile both models, exercise checkpoint and resume
One harmony fine-tune and one accompaniment fine-tune, validation and short generations
Bounded development-set learning-rate and conditioning experiments
Repeat selected settings across seeds plus matched initialization/conditioning ablations
Frozen held-out generation and component comparisons

exclusions: Provider-specific taxes and extraordinary transfer charges beyond the contingency
operating_rule: These are proposed spending allocations, not purchase authorization. Run one GPU, preserve resumable checkpoints, stop jobs at their wall-time caps, and terminate the paid instance after exporting results. Early stopping may reduce spend; a capped run is not evidence of convergence.
